name: WdPhoneticGuideAlignmentType
description: Specifies the alignment of phonetic text that is added to the specified range.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentCenter
constants.description: Microsoft Word centers phonetic text over the specified range. This is the default value.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentZeroOneZero
constants.description: Word adjusts the inside and outside spacing of the phonetic text in a 0:1:0 ratio.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentOneTwoOne
constants.description: Word adjusts the inside and outside spacing of the phonetic text in a 1:2:1 ratio.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentLeft
constants.description: Word left-aligns phonetic text with the specified range.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentRight
constants.description: Word right-aligns phonetic text with the specified range.

constants.name: wdPhoneticGuideAlignmentRightVertical
constants.description: Word aligns the phonetic text on the right side of vertical text.
